title: Career Roadmap · Kitchen Assistant
summary: Supports chefs with ingredient preparation, kitchen cleanliness, equipment handling, stock rotation and basic food-production tasks.

about.label: Common route
about.text: Class 10/12 → Kitchen / Food Production training → practical experience → Kitchen Assistant → Commis Chef.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Any stream; course eligibility varies.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: English, basic mathematics and food/nutrition topics.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Food preparation, kitchen hygiene, ingredient storage and cooking methods.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Teamwork, punctuality, cleanliness, safe knife handling and following instructions.

items.text: Diploma in Food Production → Kitchen operations and food preparation.
Diploma in Hotel Management / Catering Technology → Broader kitchen and hospitality skills.
Diploma in Bakery & Confectionery → Bakery and pastry kitchen roles.
B.Sc. Hospitality & Hotel Administration → Broader hotel operations and career progression.

blocks.text: NCHMCT lists a 1.5-year Diploma in Food Production with practical training and industrial training. Its published eligibility describes 10+2 with English; verify current admission details.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Kitchen hygiene, mise en place, ingredient preparation and safe equipment use.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Basic cooking methods, portioning, stock rotation and industrial training.

blocks.label: Year 3 / workplace experience
blocks.text: Improve speed, consistency, food-waste control and station coordination.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Mise-en-place checklist; ingredient inventory sheet; food-waste audit; standard recipe and portion guide.

blocks.label: Hotels / research kitchens
blocks.text: Hotel kitchens, institutional catering and culinary training kitchens.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Restaurants, resorts, cloud kitchens, catering companies and bakeries.

blocks.label: Potential employers
blocks.text: Taj Hotels, ITC Hotels, Marriott, Hilton and Hyatt; check official careers pages.

blocks.label: Ideal areas
blocks.text: Cold kitchen, hot kitchen, bakery, food preparation and bulk catering.
Internships and job availability are not guaranteed.

blocks.label: Further study
blocks.text: Diploma → B.Sc. Hospitality / culinary programme → broader food-production roles.

blocks.label: Specialized
blocks.text: Kitchen operations → garde manger, bakery, pastry or institutional catering.

blocks.text: Australia, Switzerland, UK, France and Canada.

UK — University of West London, hospitality-related programmes.

blocks.text: Common requirements

items.text: English or other language proficiency where required.
Passport, finances and relevant student-visa documents.
Practical experience or work placement where specified.

blocks.text: Check current programme names, costs, entry criteria and visa rules through official sources.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Kitchen Assistant, Kitchen Porter, Prep Cook, Commis Chef, Bakery Assistant.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Hotels, restaurants, resorts, cruise kitchens and catering.

items: eligible employer application or international study
blocks.label: Typical route

items.text: Direct overseas employment may be possible, but depends on experience, local work rules and employer requirements. Sponsorship is not guaranteed.

blocks.text: Kitchen Trainee ↓ Kitchen Assistant ↓ Commis Chef ↓ Demi Chef de Partie ↓ Chef de Partie ↓ Sous Chef ↓ Head Chef / Executive Chef (with relevant experience)

CLASS 10 / 12 ↓ FOOD PRODUCTION / HOTEL MANAGEMENT TRAINING ↓ KITCHEN HYGIENE + PREPARATION SKILLS ↓ PRACTICAL TRAINING / INTERNSHIP ↓ KITCHEN ASSISTANT ↓ COMMIS CHEF ↓ CHEF DE PARTIE → SOUS CHEF → HEAD CHEF
